verdict.why_en: The framework landed on Hold—the AI and cloud thesis remains intact, but RSI at 74.5 and the stock above the upper Bollinger Band mean near-term caution outweighs long-term conviction.
verdict.why_zh: 框架给出持有——AI与云业务逻辑不变，但RSI 74.5及股价突破布林上轨表明短期风险大于长期信心。

stances.en: Azure expansion and $24.1B OpenAI revenue confirm secular AI demand.
stances.zh: Azure扩张与240亿OpenAI收入确认AI长期需求。

stances.en: Social media score of 8/10 reflects overwhelmingly positive AI narrative.
stances.zh: 社交媒体评分8/10反映AI叙事积极。

stances.en: AI revenue tied to OpenAI and new cybersecurity model drive momentum.
stances.zh: AI营收与网络安全模型推动动能。

stances.en: RSI at 74.5 and price 12% above upper Bollinger Band signal overbought.
stances.zh: RSI 74.5突破布林上轨显示超买。

split.bull_en: Azure expansion and $24.1B OpenAI revenue confirm secular AI demand.
split.bull_zh: Azure扩张与240亿OpenAI收入确认AI长期需求。
split.bear_en: RSI at 74.5 and price 12% above upper Bollinger Band signal overbought.
split.bear_zh: RSI 74.5突破布林上轨显示超买。
split.pivot_en: Both sides agree the AI thesis is real, but the bull sees the 24.6% July surge as momentum confirmation, while the bear sees an overbought stock at RSI 74.5 that already priced in the good news.
split.pivot_zh: 双方都认同AI叙事真实，但多头认为24.6%的涨幅是动量确认，空头则认为RSI 74.5表明利好已被充分定价。
